name: Helicone
summary: Put a proxy in front of your model calls and get logs, cost attribution, caching and fallback routing for free-ish.
description:
Helicone's design is one base-URL change, which is why it gets adopted: every request and response is logged, spend is attributed per user or feature, caching dedupes repeated calls, and failover routing gives you a retry path when a provider degrades. Sessions and custom properties make the logs searchable in something other than raw JSON.

A proxy is also a dependency in the request path — latency, outage blast radius and the fact that payloads now transit a third party all need answering before you put it in front of regulated traffic. The self-hosted option exists, and it is the version most compliance conversations actually want.
